subject: Adding a text label to a plot (bug in Plot Builder?)

messages.author: 84d40346d2b44e80
messages.subject: Adding a text label to a plot (bug in Plot Builder?)
parts:
Hi All,

In Plot Builder, I created a scatterplot with lowess fit of a parabola and tried to add an annotation to the plot. I dragged the Text Geom on the plot and clicked the left rectangle near the boxes for x, y and label so that it would accept text instead of variables. I entered x=0, y=80 and "A Parabola" as the text. The parabola appeared, but not the label. This appears to be a bug in Plot Builder as it does not include the x and y arguments within an aes call. This amuses me to no end since I have made this same mistake countless times. It appears I'm now doing penance for my sins. The code is below.

Cheers,
Bob

# A parabola:
x <- -10:10
y <- x**2
df <- data.frame(x,y)
df

# Code created by Plot Builder (doesn't work)
ggplot() +
geom_point(aes(x = x,y = y),data=df,alpha = 0.5952) +
geom_smooth(aes(x = x,y = y),data=df,method = 'loess',formula = 'y ~ x') +
geom_text(data=df,x = 0,y = 80,label = 'A Parabola',parse = FALSE)

# Fixed version that has aes() added to geom_text:
ggplot() +
geom_point(aes(x = x,y = y),data=df,alpha = 0.5952) +
geom_smooth(aes(x = x,y = y),data=df,method = 'loess',formula = 'y ~ x') +
geom_text(data=df, aes(x = 0,y = 80),label = 'A Parabola',parse = FALSE)

messages.subject: Re: Adding a text label to a plot (bug in Plot Builder?)
parts:
I would actually argue that that is a bug in ggplot2. you should be
able to enter x and y as non-aes values. But, you can edit the x and y
aes by hand in the Builder. Right click on x and y fields in the Plot
Builder, and you can enter anything you want.

Ian
